title: Adjacent zone concatenation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a+1<n$, and let $w$ and $v$ assign a finite list of optional Boolean values to each of the $n$ indices. If the concatenations of the lists at indices $a$ and $a+1$ agree, and the lists assigned by $w$ and $v$ agree at every other index, then the concatenations of all lists in index order agree.
hypotheses_covered: The lists at indices $a$ and $a+1$ have equal concatenation
The lists agree at every index other than $a$ and $a+1$
